name: Lansbury Playing Field Play Area
description: Play area on Lansbury Playing Field, reached from Lansbury Road opposite Mary Street and John Street. It has a slide and climbing frame and swings for older children, and swings and a springer for toddlers, as Eckington Parish Council describes it.
operator: Eckington Parish Council (inspected by North East Derbyshire District Council)
